title: Mars transit

truth.label: Scripted illness (infection-like strain)
truth.detail: Scripted at 1.46 times the average real response: a peak resting heart rate rise of about 7 bpm, the published median among detected cases and near the upper quartile of real episodes. About three real episodes in ten show no heart-rate rise at all.

blurb: Four crew, 30 days of pre-flight baseline, then a 180-day outbound transit to Mars.
